provenance: Authored synthetic personas for engineering evaluation. These are not interviewed customers, adoption evidence or willingness-to-pay observations.

personas.name: Maya
personas.need: Approve a specific customer requirement while keeping the shared release review accountable.
personas.risk: A reviewed requirement is silently rewritten after approval.

personas.name: Idris
personas.need: Find an exact reproducible failing operation before spending time investigating a release.
personas.risk: A report blames the wrong source revision or test fixture.

personas.name: Elena
personas.need: Keep contractors limited to assigned project documents during the agreed access window.
personas.risk: A shared download refactor grants access the customer never approved.

personas.name: Jun
personas.need: Preserve standard workspace behavior while another customer's exception is protected.
personas.risk: The fix overrestricts unaffected tenants or reveals their private review details.

personas.name: Farah
personas.need: Inspect denied operations and independent expectations, including cross-tenant attempts.
personas.risk: The candidate changes its own oracle or a model decides what should be permitted.

personas.name: Tomas
personas.need: Inspect only the reviews belonging to teams currently managed.
personas.risk: A tenant-wide manager label accidentally grants access to another team's code and customer context.

personas.name: Amina
personas.need: Recover saved work after cancellation, process failure or restart without running checks twice.
personas.risk: An old completion overwrites a newer candidate or canceled run.

personas.name: Noah
personas.need: Compare total setup and maintenance effort with existing CI and policy tests.
personas.risk: Synthetic correctness results are sold as proof of customer demand or cost savings.
